clauses.name: Refrain Repeater
clauses.printedParagraph: If Refrain Repeater is used as tribute, at the end of that turn it returns from the Limbo to its owner's hand unless an opponent pays {H}.
clauses.expectedBehavior: A real Tribute payment moves the card to its authoritative destination and fires its used-as-Tribute trigger exactly once. A discard does not fire it; paid-Will memories require an actual Will play. The valid trigger begins the printed memory, shuffle or retained-essence result.

limits: This proof certifies real Tribute-event eligibility and the first card-specific transition, not every delayed end-of-turn branch.
